$comment: What the collector keeps. Every other attribute is dropped before anything is written. `npm run generate` writes collector/otelcol.yaml and docs/participants.md from this file; a test fails when they are out of date.

resource.service.name: Which tool sent the span: plexus or pharo-mcp.
resource.telemetry.sdk.name: The OpenTelemetry SDK that sent it.
resource.telemetry.sdk.language: The SDK's language: nodejs or pharo.
resource.os.type: The OS family: linux, darwin or windows.
resource.process.runtime.name: nodejs or pharo.
resource.process.runtime.version: Node's version, or Pharo's version and build.
resource.deployment.environment.name: field for participants, eval for our own evaluation runs, check for npm run check-deployment.

span.session.id: A random value that groups the calls of one working session, made anew for each session; never tied to a person, a machine or another session.
span.mcp.method.name: The MCP method: tools/call, tools/list, ...
span.mcp.protocol.version: The MCP protocol version, a date.
span.mcp.session.id: The random id the image's MCP server gives its connection.
span.gen_ai.operation.name: execute_tool for a tool call.
span.gen_ai.tool.name: The tool's name, when it reads as an identifier, including a name the agent asked for that no tool has.
span.error.type: How a call failed: tool_error, a JSON-RPC code, or a class from Pharo, MCP or Node.
span.network.protocol.name: http.
span.plexus.client.name: The agent host's name as it introduces itself to PLexus's server, for example claude-code.
span.plexus.argument.names: The names of the arguments a call to PLexus's server gave, never their values.
span.plexus.argument.unknown_names: Argument names a call gave that PLexus's own image tools do not take.
span.plexus.image.from_base: Whether a new image was copied from a prepared base.
span.plexus.image.save: Whether stopping an image saved it.
span.pharo.mcp.dispatch_path: How the image dispatched the request.
span.pharo.mcp.argument.names: The names of the arguments the image received, never their values.
span.pharo.mcp.argument.unknown_names: Argument names the tool does not declare.
span.pharo.mcp.output_budget.exceeded: Whether the answer was longer than the budget.
span.pharo.mcp.error.kind: The kind of error MCP reported.
span.pharo.mcp.error.schema.violation_count: How many schema rules the arguments broke.
span.pharo.mcp.exception.type: The nearest Pharo or MCP class of an exception.
